reviewType: Supplemental source-aware disposition of eight maintained-identity screening candidates
styleBasis: Retain recognizable identity of named factions/creatures and whole identifying phrase with pronunciation.
A common noun is not automatically a proper name; translate ordinary narrative naturally.
Do not apply blanket retained-English annotations to lexical screening matches.

dispositions.reason: NO_CHANGE: source says “within the temple” as ordinary location language. Myanmar ဘုရားကျောင်းထဲမှာ retains that meaning; inserting generic maintained Temple would not establish a named building. Godrick whole name is already retained and objective independently names Temple of the Damned.
NO_CHANGE: ancient modifies the age of the warlock Cazul, not a creature/race named Ancient. အသက်ကြီးရင့်လှတဲ့ preserves old age; retain existing Cazul and warlock annotations.

CHANGES_REQUIRED: source wind rider tower currently becomes a human air-rider tower. Preserve maintained Wind Rider identity and ordinary tower noun in the attached full-field proposal; direction and recipient remain exact.

NO_CHANGE: source ordinary “symbol of love” is semantically translated ချစ်ခြင်းမေတ္တာရဲ့ သင်္ကေတ, not an item named Symbol. Source “the Barrens of Kalimdor” retains recognizable Barrens with maintained ဘဲရန်းစ် and Kalimdor; omission of the English article is a legitimate established place shortening.
NO_CHANGE: Barrens (ဘဲရန်းစ်) is recognizable and matches the current source location; The Barrens/Barrens share the maintained pronunciation. No identity or direction is lost by article omission.

NO_CHANGE: lowercased “the cathedral” is a short landmark reference in a rebuke, not a newly stated full building name. ဘုရားကျောင်းကြီး renders cathedral naturally, and the sentence preserves being far from it, exact <class>, and no authority here. STYLE-GUIDE says common nouns are not automatically proper names; do not insert an unsupported full-name expansion or blanket annotation.

CHANGES_REQUIRED: Blackrock plus translated clan preserves meaning, but full Blackrock Clan named faction identity and its combined maintained phonetic should remain one unit under STYLE-GUIDE. Attached proposal makes that specific adjustment.

NO_CHANGE: shattered is an ordinary adjective describing broken orb remains, not a named Shattered target. ကွဲကြေသွားတဲ့ and မှော်လုံးအပိုင်းအစတွေ preserve the physical condition; no English annotation is warranted.
